info.title: Spend Brake admin API
info.description: Keys, caps, kill switch, provider credentials, spend and events.

reboundKeys.description: Keys that were bound to a deleted credential of this provider and now use this one

delete.summary: Delete a provider key (keys that use it move to another key of the provider) (admin)

post.summary: Create a virtual key (the token is shown once) (admin)

put.summary: Set hard / soft caps for a scope, per day and/or month (null removes a limit) (admin)

delete.summary: Remove the caps of a scope (admin)

post.summary: Stop all spend for an org, provider, key or session (immediate) (admin)
Resume a key paused by the loop breaker (close its circuit before the cooldown ends) (admin)

get.summary: Live remaining budget per scope (from Valkey) (viewer)

schema.description: Defaults to the org and every active key

parameters.description: Defaults to the org and every active key
parameters.name: scope

paused.description: Keys refused for a loop (429 loop_detected) until the circuit closes

get.summary: Spend from the ledger, grouped by key, SKU, day, ... (viewer)
Usage events (newest first), or the audit log with source=audit (viewer)

post.summary: Create an admin API token (shown once) (owner)

put.summary: Update org settings (time zone, provider pricing policy, loop policy) (owner)

post.summary: Add an alert webhook (the signing secret is shown once) (admin)

get.summary: Delivery log of a webhook (newest first) (viewer)

post.summary: Run an alert action link (kill, raise, mute, reset circuit); the token is the credential
Mint a session key (admin token, or X-Brake-Key of a parent key with canMintSessions)

delete.summary: End a session: revoke its key and report its spend (admin, parent or the session key)

post.summary: First run: create the org and its owner token (needs BRAKE_SETUP_TOKEN)

get.summary: Remaining budget of the calling virtual key (X-Brake-Key)

post.summary: Price the last N days of Google Maps usage on Geoapify, Stadia Maps, Open Places API, Mapbox and HERE (viewer)
Email a sign-in link (public; works once, for 15 minutes)

202.description: Sent if the address belongs to anyone

post.summary: Spend an emailed sign-in link for a token (public)

get.summary: The calling token: its org and role (the dashboard shows only what the role can do) (viewer)

delete.summary: Sign out: end the calling session (tokens issued at sign-in only) (viewer)

post.summary: Invite a person (emails them a sign-in link when email sign-in is on) (owner)

patch.summary: Change a person's role (their current sessions end) (owner)

delete.summary: Remove a person from the org (their sessions end) (owner)

get.summary: The org's calls, cost, latency and budget in the Prometheus text format (viewer)
Where calls go as OpenTelemetry spans (null when nowhere) (viewer)

planAllows.description: False when the org's plan no longer includes export: nothing is sent

put.summary: Send every call as a span to the org's OTLP/HTTP collector (admin)

planAllows.description: False when the org's plan no longer includes export: nothing is sent

delete.summary: Stop sending spans (and drop the ones waiting) (admin)

post.summary: Send one test span to the configured collector now (admin)
